resources.string: A live clock whose aurora background follows the light of day. Also sits on your lock screen.
A live deep-work timer. Start it, and the countdown follows you to the lock screen.
Your own photo on the home screen, with a caption if you want one. Pick it once and it stays.
One quiet word, changing through the day. Nothing to tap, nothing to manage.
A passage a day, from the source you choose: scripture, Stoic philosophy, poetry or proverbs. Always shown with its reference.
A Turkish proverb or idiom every four hours, with its meaning and an example. From 400 sayings.
For quitting smoking. Your lungs fill as your body recovers, with days smoke-free and the money you kept. Tap the lungs to breathe.
Days until the day you are waiting for: a trip, a wedding, an exam. One dot per day, filling as it gets closer.
How much of the day, week, month or year has passed, or of your life. A big number and one dot per unit.
Design your own from scratch: pick a background, add your text, drop in stickers, exactly how you want it.
A warm gradient and a soft greeting. Change the words to whatever you want to read at a glance.
A nudge to drink water, sitting where you already look a hundred times a day.
One instruction, in monospace, on a cold dark gradient. For the hours that matter.
Soft pink into periwinkle, with room for a short hello. The friendliest thing on the screen.
Today in one word and one emoji. Edit it whenever the mood turns.
A small private thing for a person you like. Two words and a heart.
A single line to hold you to one thing at a time. Heavy serif on near-black.
Electric magenta bleeding into deep violet. Loud, on purpose.
A warm paper card with a prompt you finish yourself. Rewrite it each morning.
Black type on off-white, and nothing else. The one that disappears into a clean home screen.
This feature is not available yet.
Details and setup are coming in a later update.
Show all widgets to change their order.
